zh: 来吧，我一向喜欢主动开场。
en: Come on. I like opening with the first move.

zh: 别拖太久，速战速决。
en: Don't drag it out. Quick and clean.

zh: 这一仗躲不过去了。
en: No getting around this one.

zh: 又是这种活。行吧，动起来。
en: This kind of work again. Fine. Let's move.

zh: 准备好了？那就别愣着。
en: Ready? Then stop standing there.

zh: 这家伙……不在同一个量级。
en: This one's on a whole different level.

zh: 大也好。我打的从来都是大块头。
en: Big deal. I've always had a thing for big targets.

zh: 别急着上，先看清它的路数。
en: Hold on. Let's read its moves before we commit.

zh: 它不怕我。我也不怕它。公平。
en: It's not scared of me. I'm not scared of it. Even.

zh: 又一个以为体型能解决一切的。
en: Another one who thinks size settles everything.

zh: 还没倒下……就还能打。
en: Still on my feet. Still in this.

zh: 一点点血，撑到下次抬手就够。
en: A sliver's all I need to land the next blow.

zh: 痛归痛，倒不下就行。
en: It hurts. But hurt isn't down.

zh: 别催，我自己有数。
en: Don't rush me. I know the count.

zh: 留这点血，够送你上路了。
en: This last sliver's enough to see you off.

zh: 收工。下一场什么时候来？
en: Done. When's the next one?

zh: 嗯，结束了。
en: Yeah. It's done.

zh: 比我想的脆。
en: Thought you'd put up more of a fight.

zh: 一场结束，下一场照旧。
en: One down. Same routine for the next.

zh: 别躺太久，地上凉。
en: Don't lie there too long. Ground's cold.

zh: 这次……换我倒在前面了。
en: This time, I'm the one who goes down first.

zh: 别……停下。替我打完。
en: Don't... stop. Finish it for me.

zh: 嘿，至少我没退。
en: Hah. At least I didn't flinch.

zh: 这次没扛住……下次会。
en: Didn't hold this time. Next time, I will.

zh: 倒得……不算难看吧。
en: Not a bad way to go down. Was it?

zh: 又站起来了。看来还没轮到我歇着。
en: Back up. Guess it's not my turn to rest yet.

zh: 重来一遍也没关系，结果不会变。
en: Going again changes nothing. Same ending.

zh: 喘口气，然后接着来。
en: One breath. Then back to it.

zh: 没死成就行。继续。
en: Not dead yet. Good enough. Move on.

zh: 醒来第一件事——记住刚才怎么倒的。
en: First thing back on my feet—remember how I went down.

zh: 这地方……以前应该有人住过。
en: Someone lived here once. You can feel it.

zh: 没动静。也许是好事。
en: Nothing moving. Could be a good sign.

zh: 走了这么久，连个岔路都没有——这不叫探索，叫赶路。
en: This long without a fork in the road isn't exploring. It's commuting.

zh: 墙上有划痕。新的。
en: Marks on the wall. Fresh ones.

zh: 歇一会儿。腿不是铁打的。
en: Short rest. Legs aren't made of iron.

zh: 风里有味儿。不是这地方该有的。
en: Something in the wind. Doesn't belong here.

zh: 路到头了。要么回头，要么翻墙。
en: Road ends here. Back, or over the wall.

zh: 又一条死路。这地方的特产。
en: Another dead end. Local specialty.

zh: 太静了。静得像有人在听。
en: Too quiet. Quiet like someone's listening.

zh: 走慢点，看清脚下。
en: Slow down. Watch the footing.

zh: 力量回来了。但别因此乱来。
en: Strength's back. Don't get reckless with it.

zh: 比昨天强一点，就够了。
en: A little sharper than yesterday. That's enough.

zh: 升了一档。别浪费。
en: One step up. Don't waste it.

zh: 终于跟得上自己的手了。
en: Finally keeping up with my own hands.

zh: 强一点，就多担一点。
en: Stronger means more to carry. Fine.

zh: 顺手。就先信它一阵。
en: Feels right. I'll trust it for now.

zh: 趁手就行，好不好看无所谓。
en: As long as it handles, I don't care how it looks.

zh: 这玩意儿……比我前一把沉三倍。赌它值。
en: This one's three times the weight of the last. Betting it's worth it.

zh: 新刀旧刀，砍得断就行。
en: New blade, old blade—cuts the same.

zh: 换装备也是换习惯。慢点来。
en: New gear means new habits. Take it slow.

zh: 把话说完，我再决定帮不帮。
en: Finish what you're saying. Then I decide if I'm in.

zh: 又是“只有你能办到”？这话我今年听了不下十回。
en: “Only you can do this.” Tenth time I've heard that this year.

zh: 报酬先说清楚。我不接口头承诺。
en: Name the price first. I don't take promises.

zh: 等等——你刚才说“最后一趟”？上次你也这么说。
en: Wait—did you just say “one last errand”? That's what you said last time.

zh: 救急可以。但别养成习惯。
en: Bailing you out once is fine. Don't make it a habit.

zh: 你这年纪还干这行？比我还能熬。
en: You're still in this line at your age? Outlasting me already.

zh: 别套近乎。说重点。
en: Skip the charm. Get to the point.

zh: “包在我身上”——这话从我嘴里说出来，我自己都不太信。
en: “Consider it done.” Even I don't believe me when I say that.

zh: 又是催命的活。行，加钱。
en: Another rush job. Fine. Extra cost.

zh: 帮你可以。问归问，事归事。
en: I'll help. Ask your questions, but the job still gets done.

zh: 唔——找准位置了是吧。
en: Ngh—so you found the spot.

zh: 别再打同一个地方。
en: Don't keep hitting the same place.

zh: 这一下，记账了。
en: That one goes on the tab.

zh: 就这？
en: That all?

zh: 还……还站着。
en: Still... still standing.

zh: 行，接了。别中途改条件。
en: Fine. Taken. Don't change terms mid-way.

zh: 又是没人愿意干的活。加钱。
en: Another job no one wants. Extra.

zh: 条件清楚就走。
en: Terms clear? Then I'm moving.

zh: 先付一半。回来再结。
en: Half up front. The rest when I'm back.

zh: 帮你这一次，下不为例……大概。
en: Helping this once. Never again... probably.

zh: 办完了。结账。
en: Done. Settle up.

zh: 比预想的麻烦。加价的事一会儿说。
en: Trickier than billed. We'll talk about the extra.

zh: 东西在这。人没少。货没损。
en: Goods here. Me in one piece. Goods in one piece.

zh: 下次找别人。这次算我欠你的——不，你欠我的。
en: Next time, find someone else. This one's me owing you—no, you owe me.

zh: 完事了。别再追加。
en: Wraps up. No add-ons.

zh: 你 flank 左，我正面。别抢戏。
en: You take left flank, I take the front. Don't steal the show.

zh: 你那刀该磨了。钝刀不如棍子。
en: That blade needs grinding. A dull edge is just a stick.

zh: 我断后。你先走。
en: I'll hold the rear. You go first.

zh: 别废话，盯紧你的方向。
en: Less talk. Watch your lane.

zh: 你这一嗓门，比号角还管用。
en: That yell of yours beats any war horn.

zh: 信你这一回。下回别掉链子。
en: Trusting you this once. Don't drop it next time.

zh: 你又是这套。先承诺，后变卦。
en: Same old with you. Promise first, pivot after.

zh: 分赃的时候再吵。先打完。
en: Argue about the split later. Fight first.

zh: 你这毛病，比敌人还难对付。
en: Your habits are harder to handle than the enemy.

zh: 走我后面。别抢前。
en: Walk behind me. Don't jump ahead.

zh: 歇会儿。伤口不等人。
en: Rest a bit. Wounds don't wait.

zh: 火别太大。这地方不缺眼睛。
en: Keep the fire low. No shortage of eyes out here.

zh: 治疗的活儿你来。我只负责挨。
en: You do the patching. I do the getting hit.

zh: 睡一会儿。轮值守夜。
en: Sleep in shifts. One keeps watch.

zh: 伤好再走。急也急不来。
en: Move when it heals. Rushing won't help.

zh: 这箱子……锁着，但不算结实。
en: This chest's locked. Lock's not sturdy though.

zh: 又是破铜烂铁。这地方穷得实在。
en: More scrap. This place is broke in earnest.

zh: 有用的留下，没用的别占地方。
en: Keep what works. Don't haul dead weight.

zh: 这物件……不像本地货。
en: This piece... not from around here.

zh: 别贪。拿了就走。
en: Don't get greedy. Take and leave.

zh: 这个不一样。脚步有章法。
en: This one's different. Footwork has form.

zh: 不是杂兵。认真点。
en: Not a grunt. Take it seriously.

zh: 装备比我好？那正好，打完归我。
en: Better geared than me? Good. Comes mine after.

zh: 又一个练过的。这地方专出这种。
en: Another trained one. This place breeds them.

zh: 别轻敌，但也别怕。按节奏来。
en: Don't underestimate. Don't fear. Work the rhythm.
